# MarketGrowth

> MarketGrowth (MarketGrowth CX LLC) is a digital innovation studio. It starts, builds and operates its own business ventures, each built with an AI-powered workflow from the very start. The portfolio below is the current set, and more are on the way. The studio does not sell agency retainers. It owns the companies it builds. Based in Sacramento, California. Founded by Victor Ramayrat.

## Ventures

- [Orbytt](https://orbytt.ai): A talent network for AI-ready Filipino virtual assistants. Employers read real profiles and hire directly. Orbytt Academy trains the talent on AI tools. Category: talent marketplace.
- [AEMfix](https://aemfix.com): Answer engine visibility software. AEMfix tracks how often AI assistants name a brand, finds the content gaps behind a weak answer, and publishes the pages that close them. It also sells a done-for-you AEO and GEO Starter Package. Category: SaaS.
- [Socient](https://socient.net): An AI-native digital studio for nonprofits and social enterprises. It builds websites, content systems and AI visibility programs, and publishes research breakdowns for mission-driven teams. Category: nonprofit sector services.
- [DirectCare](https://directcarehq.com): Consulting and compliance products for owners of small ICF/DD-H and ICF/DD-N homes in California. Licensing support, individual program plans, staff training plans and survey readiness. Contract QIDP services are sold through QIDP Consultant (qidpconsultant.com). Category: health and disability services.
- [AgentLedGTM](https://agentledgtm.com): A publication and tool library for agent-led growth. Playbooks, interactive tools and research for go-to-market engineers. Category: media.
- Mission:Told: A digital publication for nonprofit organizations. It will report on the tools, funding and operating practices that nonprofit teams use, on the web and through digital downloads. Category: media. Status: work in progress, not yet launched.

## Company

- [Ventures](https://marketgrowth.io/ventures): The full list of companies the studio builds and operates.
- [How we build](https://marketgrowth.io/how-we-build): The four-stage operating model, the six principles the studio works by, and an FAQ about the studio. MarketGrowth CX LLC is the publisher of record for the studio's media properties. Victor Ramayrat is the founder.

## How the studio works

The operating model is written up at [How we build](https://marketgrowth.io/how-we-build). Four stages run as a loop.

- Find: start only in markets the studio already operates in. The signal comes from its own media properties and daily work.
- Prove: sell the offer before building the product. A page, a free tool and a manual service test whether anyone pays.
- Build: a small team ships the product with an agent stack, on a shared design system and publishing pipeline.
- Operate: the studio runs the company after launch and owns the outcome. What it learns returns to the first stage.

Six principles guide the work, drawn from the best customer service, first principles, and the belief that a business exists to leave people better off: start with the customer and work backward; whoever hears the problem owns it; reason from what is true, not from what is usual; break a challenge down to its most basic, undeniable truths; profit is the means and benefit is the purpose; report the impact, not only the revenue.
